Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_01M_L2: I have a finding and nobody to tell it to. Please.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_01_L2: Shuttle. The Doctor. I have been reading. Don't sigh.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02P_L1: A colleague. Before my time, and everybody's.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02P_L2: He wrote beautifully. Almost as well as I do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L1: Medical logs. The old ones. Two hundred and eighty
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L2: years of them, filed and unread, which is a crime.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L3: In 2153 a Denobulan named Phlox stopped nanoprobes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L4: Borg nanoprobes, in a crewman, with omicron radiation.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L5: He wrote it down. I appear to be the first to read it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_O2: What does that mean for us?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_03_L1: It fills in the half I couldn't read. Something Borg is
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_03_L2: holding those bodies together and keeping them moving.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_03_L3: And omicron radiation takes nanoprobes apart.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04K_L1: They're already dead. You'd be switching them off.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04K_L2: Whether that's different from killing, I haven't decided.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L1: No. I want to be very clear, because it's tempting.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L2: It's a note in a file. It needs a laboratory, months,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L3: and a ship that can go somewhere. We have none of it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L4: But it tells us what this is made of. I'd call that progress.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_05_L1: I have. She cried, which I am choosing to take well.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_01M_L2: Shepard. The probe's signal. Have you looked yet?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_01_L2: Shepard. Your probe flagged something. Not dilithium.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_L1: A holo emitter. A small one, very old. Three hundred
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_L2: years, give or take, in a world that shouldn't have
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_L3: a holo emitter at all. Somebody left a recording.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_O2: Why would anyone do that here?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L1: There's a file on this planet. You'll have heard
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L2: of the Q. Starfleet's view is that one made this place.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L3: A copy of Earth, dropped here, for a joke or a test.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L4: It's the only box they have for it. It's a fair guess.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_04_L1: I believe I'd like to hear the recording.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_04_L2: Bring it to me, off the PADD. Hail me with it on you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_04_L3: And don't die with it. It's the only one we know of.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_ALL_L1: That's all six on the shelf now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_ALL_L3: I'll call you when I've listened. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_EARLY_L1: On the shelf. Out of order, but he numbered them,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_EARLY_L2: bless him. A historian's dream. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F1_L1: It's a man. Old, recording himself. It's numbered one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F1_L2: He says he was something that doesn't die, once.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F1_L3: Curious about a species that does. I'm dubbing it now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F2_L1: Number two. He's talking about a woman, very gently.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F2_L2: He says his kind can't love anything. And then he did.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F2_L3: It's going on tape. You'll want to watch this one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F3_L1: Three. It's about her dying. A war over furs.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F3_L2: Fought by people she'd never met, miles away.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F3_L3: I'm putting it on tape. I'm not going to watch it twice.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F4_L1: Four. He copied the whole valley, down to the falls.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F4_L2: And the people on it. Her too.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F4_L3: That's... I need a minute. It's going on tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F5_L1: Five. He gave it up. The power. Made himself mortal
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F5_L2: so he could grow old with her. And he wonders if he
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F5_L3: ever told her what she was. Taping it now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F6_L1: Six. He's old. Dying, I think. And he's talking to
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F6_L2: whoever found this. To you, I suppose. Not by name.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F6_L3: He knew the world would outlive them both. Taping it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_FIRSTONE_L1: It'll be on the shelf by the television. One of six,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_FIRSTONE_L2: he says. The Q file is going to hate this. Or love it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_FIRSTONE_L3: Find the rest if you can. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANGT_L1: The television takes tape. So everything goes on tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANGT_L2: Once it's on the shelf, it can't be lost. Ready?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANG_L2: Shepard. You found it? Hold it up to the PADD.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANG_L4: Hang on. I can put that on magnetic tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANG_L5: It's what I've been doing with holos all year.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_LAST_L1: One left. I've been counting days by these.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_MID_L1: That's half of him, near enough, on the shelf.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_MID_L2: Whoever he was, he meant these to be found.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_NONE_L1: I'm not reading one on you. Did you drop it?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_NONE_L2: Hail me again when it's in your hands. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01M_L2: Okafor. I called once already. I don't usually.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01Q_L1: Then I'll answer the one you didn't ask.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01S_L1: Asleep, for once. This is not her conversation.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01_L2: Commander Okafor. You don't know me. Shepard does.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01_L3: She tells me you have questions about my employer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_02_L1: It wasn't us. It wasn't anyone I know of.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_02_L2: We did not disable this ship. We did not do that
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_02_L3: to the county below you. We were as blind as she was.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03B_L1: Don't, particularly. Believe what the Doctor finds.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03P_L1: It is. If it were us, I would not be calling you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03P_L2: I'd be letting you believe it. It's cheaper.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03W_L1: Because she will not hear it from me any more.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03W_L2: And because whoever did this is still out there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_L1: I can't. There is nothing I could show you that
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_L2: an organisation like mine could not also forge.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_L3: You're right not to trust us. We earned that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_O1: Then why should anyone trust you?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_O2: All right. I'll let it go.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04T_L1: They shouldn't. Go by the evidence.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04T_L2: The Doctor's reading half a signature. Follow that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_05_L1: Five months she's been angry at the wrong people.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_05_L2: Somebody left the room before we were blinded,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_05_L3: and came back for the test. I want to know who.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_01M_L2: Twice now. I'm going to keep calling about this one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_01_L2: Shepard. I want to talk about my people. The eleven.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02N_L1: Nobody has come up yet. That isn't a complaint.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02N_L2: Beacons come and go. The shuttle hears them first.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02R_L1: You've already brought some of them up. %2, last.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02R_L2: I read the quarantine log every morning.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03C_L1: Nobody asked you to. Least of all me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03C_L2: Bring me one and I'll be grateful.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03C_O1: What happens to them up there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03W_L1: Some can't walk. Some are in a basement with forty
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03W_L2: of the dead on the stairs. They can't just walk out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03W_O1: What happens to them up there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L2: Eleven went down. The beacons don't say who's calling.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L3: I trained some of them. A couple I barely knew.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L4: Some have stopped, and I don't know which of those
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L5: are dead and which just dropped the combadge.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_O1: What happens to them up there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_O2: Why don't they walk to a clearing?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_04_L1: Quarantine. Blood tests, mostly, and the Doctor.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_04_L2: Then a bunk, and a lot of staring at the viewport.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_04_L3: Nobody has turned. He doesn't know why yet.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_05Y_L1: Yet. You and he would get on.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_05_L1: Keep answering them. The ship pays you for each one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_05_L2: I can only say thank you. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01MM_L2: Third time. I'm going to assume you're busy.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01MM_L3: Or dead. I would rather busy. Answer if you can.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_L2: Shuttlecraft, Adirondack. Second time of asking.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_L3: I know somebody is down there. The core keeps count.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_O1: Sorry. I'm here. Who is this?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_O3: Is anyone coming to get us?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01S_L1: Nothing. All right. Then I'll talk, and you listen.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01S_L2: If you're hurt or scared, fine. Just listen.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_L2: Shuttlecraft, this is the Adirondack. Please respond.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_L3: Somebody has been aboard my shuttle. The core says so.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_L4: If you can hear me, say something. Anything at all.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_O1: I hear you. Who is this?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_O3: Is anyone coming to get us?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02H_L1: No. I'm sorry. Nobody is coming. Not for years.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02H_L2: I'd rather tell you that now than have you hope.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02R_L1: Ha. No. Mine. Logged item by item, every lamp.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02R_L2: But you're alive and you found her, so she's yours now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02R_L3: Look after her. She's the only one left down there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L1: Lieutenant Lucy Shepard. Cultural survey. And that
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L2: is my shuttle you're standing in. Everything in it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L3: Including the chair, which I'd quite like back one day.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L4: I have talked to the same hundred and forty faces
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L5: since July. You are the first new voice in months.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03J_L1: You know what happened in July. You're living in it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03J_L2: I meant up here. It's been a long summer in orbit.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03_L1: So. Who am I talking to?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03_O1: I'm from around here. I found this in a field.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03_O3: My name's %1. That's all you get.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L1: A local. Of course you are. Of course you are.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L2: Then I owe you an apology. A big one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L3: We were up here watching when it happened to you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L4: We wrote it all down, and we didn't lift a finger.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04Q_L1: Nothing? All right. I'll call you the shuttle, then.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04Q_L2: Plenty of people up here I'd rather not know better.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04S_L2: Nobody told me. Nobody told any of us anything.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04S_L3: I'll take it. I'm not in any position to check.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04S_L4: And frankly, I've stopped caring whose side anyone is on.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04X_L1: Fair. I wouldn't tell me either, after this summer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L1: Three things, and then you can hang up on me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L2: One. I'm alive. So are a hundred and forty others.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L3: Two. The Adirondack cannot leave. No warp. No impulse.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_O2: Then get me out of here.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_O3: Why tell me any of this?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06Q_L1: You shouldn't. I'm not going to pretend otherwise.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06Q_L2: The ship pays for it. Patterns for the replicator,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06Q_L3: supplies. And any of them would do it for you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L1: I would. I can't. Not yet, and it isn't my call.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L2: The Doctor won't bring anyone up from the surface
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L3: until he knows how it spreads. Quarantine. Hard stop.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L4: I'm sorry. I know what that means for you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06W_L1: Because you're in my shuttle, and my shuttle works.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06W_L2: And because there are people down there who are mine.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L1: Eleven of my crew stayed on the ground. For the work.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L2: Some of them are still calling. Distress beacons.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L3: Your shuttle hears them. I can't find them without you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L4: Get to one, call it in, and we pull them up from here.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_O1: I'll see what I can do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_O2: Why should I risk my neck for your people?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07A_L1: Then you know more than Starfleet does.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07A_L2: Not that that's saying much. I'm sorry you had to.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07A_L3: And you know about the chair. Don't sit in it for me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07_L1: One more thing. This one's for me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07_L2: The tapes by the television. They're mine. Watch them.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07_L3: Everything I know about what happened is on those.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_08_L1: I'll call again. Or you call me, off your PADD.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_08_L2: Most of the time nobody answers up here. Try anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_01M_L2: Shepard. When you have a minute. About the six.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_01_L2: Shepard. I've watched all six. Twice.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02Q_L1: I'm writing it up. I'm not going to write it that way.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02Q_L2: I'm going to write what he said. They can decide.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L1: His name was Tucker Gold. The name he chose, when he
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L2: stopped being what he was. That's in number five.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L3: There's a case like him on file. Rana Four. A Douwd.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L4: A kind that can make a world, or end one, when it grieves.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_O1: He made all this? The whole county?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L1: The land and the river, and the people on it. Then
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L2: he put it down and grew old with her, and the towns
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L3: grew on their own for three hundred years.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L4: Your parents were real. Your town was real. Is.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_04_L1: It's real either way. That part I'd swear to.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_04_L2: The place was made. The people weren't. Nobody made you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_04_L3: Thank you for bringing him in. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_01M_L2: Shepard. No emergency. When you've got a second.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_01_L2: Shepard. Nothing's wrong. I just want to say a thing
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_01_L3: out loud to somebody who'll understand it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L1: A Douwd made this county because he couldn't bear
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L2: one death. A Changeling is emptying it because it
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L3: couldn't bear a genocide. I keep turning that over.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L4: And each of them the last of something, on their own.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03E_L1: No. I'm only explaining it. It's all I'm good for.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L1: Us? At least we're not on our own.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L2: A hundred and forty up here. You down there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L3: And the ones you've brought up.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L4: It won't fix anything. Anyway. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_01_L2: It's Shepard. %2's beacon stopped an hour ago.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_01_L3: I don't blame you. I just wanted somebody else
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_01_L4: to hear the name out loud.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_02_L1: I know. Nobody could. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_03_L1: There will. That's the worst thing anyone's said today.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_01_L2: Adirondack. Shepard. Everything all right down there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_01_O1: I want you to stop calling.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_02_L2: All right. I can do that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_02_L3: The shuttle will still hear the beacons. That's hers.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_02_L4: If you ever want me, hail. I'll pick up if I can.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_RESUME_02_L1: I will, then. Sparingly. I promise.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_RESUME_03_L1: Still here. Still going nowhere. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_01M_L2: Shepard. Please pick up. This one's important.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_01_L2: Shepard. Are you somewhere you can sit down?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L1: We put the pieces together. Okafor, the Doctor, me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L2: The Founders' virus and Borg nanoprobes, in one engine.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L3: A Changeling left the Great Link, years ago, on purpose.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L4: It knew what Section 31 did to its people. The virus.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L5: And it spent sixty years making that into this.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_O1: I know. It's on your last tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03T_L1: Then you know I left the chair where it was. Good.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03T_L2: What the tape doesn't have is the part that's next.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03_L1: Just one of them, on its own. I can't get past that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03_L2: One person, grieving for long enough, did all of it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L1: Because nobody was watching. There wasn't even a relay.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L2: An order saying do not interfere. The Prime Directive
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L3: is what left this world undefended. I helped write it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L4: And because your world is the closest thing to Earth
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L5: anybody has ever found. It's a rehearsal.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_L1: For the Federation. The worlds that did this to it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_L2: A horde is a Collective with no Queen, and nobody at
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_L3: home knows it exists. We can't warn them. Comms dark.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_O1: Then we have to get word out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_O2: What do you want me to do?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06N_L1: No. It's the one that watched you die and took notes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06N_L2: You don't owe it anything. I'm not going to ask.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06_L1: Stay alive. Keep bringing my people up, and keep the tapes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06_L2: If a ship ever does come, I want the whole record.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06_L3: All of it, in the order it happened.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_Title: The one who left the Link
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01M_L2: I did say they wouldn't pick up. I said it twice.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01M_L3: You did. Shuttle, have you got a moment?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01_L2: Shepard. I've got the Doctor with me. Ours.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01_L3: Good afternoon. Or whatever it is on the surface.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01_O2: Is this going to be bad news?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02E_L1: Your shuttle's hologram has been sending me readings.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02E_L2: Sensibly formatted, which I did not expect from a
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02E_L3: copy of myself. I suppose I should be flattered.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02S_L1: The crew you've sent up brought samples on their boots.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02S_L2: Accidentally. I have made the most of them.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03P_L1: Two different things did this. I can see one of them.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03P_L2: The other is only an outline. A gap in the data.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L1: The dead down there are not dead in the usual way.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L2: Something rebuilt them. Morphogenic markers, yes,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L3: the Founders' own chemistry, which is bad enough.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L4: But there's a second signature underneath it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L5: Something is holding the tissue together. Running it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04M_L1: It matters to me. It'll matter to whoever gets home.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04M_L2: It matters to a cure. Which is my department.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04W_L1: I think it is two people who never met. One made
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04W_L2: the poison and one made the engine. Don't quote me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L1: I don't know. I do so dislike saying that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L2: I can support the chemistry. I cannot support the author.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L3: He keeps saying that. It still sounds like Section 31.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L4: It sounds like whoever you have already decided on.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_O2: Who do you think it is?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L1: The living, if they're caught early? Your shuttle
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L2: does that already, at a price. The dead? No.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L3: I'm sorry. I would like to be wrong about that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L4: Thank you, Doctor. Shuttle, Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_01M_L2: I tried you yesterday. I'll assume the dead were busy.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_01M_L3: Have you got a minute now?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_01_L2: Shepard. Have you got a minute? A real one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02X_L1: I owe the ten who stayed because I did. You'll do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_L1: Something you asked, or didn't. Why I stayed down.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_L2: February to July, on the ground, with a ship overhead
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_L3: begging me to come up. I owe somebody the answer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_O3: I figured it was the work.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L1: Because it was the best work anybody in my field
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L2: will ever get to do. A world that didn't know we were there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L3: And because I could pass. Six months of market days.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L4: The others could sit in orbit and read my notes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L5: Ten of them didn't. They came down because I did.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_L1: That's kind. Command doesn't work like that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_L2: People follow a lieutenant who goes down first.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_L3: I knew that. I went anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_O1: Then that's yours to live with.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04BS_L1: It was also fair. Don't take it back.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04BT_L1: It is. I'll be carrying it a long time.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04BT_L2: You don't have to carry it with me. That's all.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04B_L2: Some of them. Yes. Say it again if it helps you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04B_L3: It doesn't help me, but I'm not the one down there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04C_L1: Knowing what I know now? No.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04C_L2: Knowing what I knew then? Yes. Every time.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04C_L3: I know. I've had five months to think about it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_L1: They've asked me to ask you to come up. For the file.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_L2: I told them it's quarantine and you'd say no anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_L3: Would you? If the Doctor cleared it?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_O2: No. Somebody has to stay down here.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_O3: Ask me when he's cleared it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06L_L1: Fair. I'll ask. He'll say not yet. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06N_L2: Now you know why I stayed. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06Y_L1: Then I hope he's quick. I really do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06Y_L2: Until then the beacons are yours. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_01_L2: It's Shepard. %2 is aboard. In quarantine, but aboard.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_02_L1: Thin. Filthy. Asked for coffee before a blanket.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_02_L2: The Doctor says that's a good sign. I think he's lying.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_02_O1: Tell them they owe me one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_03_L1: I'll tell them. And thank you. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_10_2: Stuck between decks three and four. Again.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_11_2: Out of the box at last.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_13_1: Is the board clear? Any beacons?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_15_1: I came as soon as I heard the chime.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_16_2: Schedule says I'm on pads until twenty-two hundred.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_17_1: Energising... oh. I'm on the pad. Sorry. Wrong way.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_18_1: That's the last time I beam instead of taking the lift.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_19_1: Stepping off. All my atoms, I think.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_5_1: That lift smells of burnt toast again.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_5_2: Somebody's been eating in the lift.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_arrive_9_1: Five minutes late. Nobody look at me.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_12_1: Morning. Is the galley open yet?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_12_2: Have you eaten? The galley's open.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_13_1: Evening. Grieg's doing real bread tonight.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_13_2: Real bread tonight. Pass it on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_19_1: Sorry, am I in your way?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_19_2: Excuse me, can I squeeze past?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_20_1: Hello. Have we met? I'm sure we've met.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_22_3: At ease. We're all at ease now.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_23_1: Did you hear? Another one came up.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_23_2: Good news on the pads today.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_24_1: Mind the deck plating, it's loose there.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_26_2: Coffee's terrible today. Just so you know.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_27_1: Good morning. Lovely view of the planet today.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_28_1: Hello. You look like you've been working.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_30_1: Hello. Nice to see a new face. Or an old one.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_30_2: Hi. Remind me your name later?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_32_1: Good to see you up and about.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_33_3: Excuse me, sir. Or ma'am. Sorry.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_36_1: Watch your step, the carpet's lifting.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_37_2: Best view on the ship. Nothing moves.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_39_1: Captain's not here, if you're looking for her.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_41_1: Sorry. I'm usually better with faces.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_42_1: Grab a station, if you like. There's plenty.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_44_1: Come to see the core? She's lovely today.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_45_2: Don't touch the blue one either.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_46_1: Engineering. Who've you come to shout at?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_47_1: Hands off the master display, please.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_47_2: Please don't lean on the display.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_48_1: You look like you need a spanner.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_49_1: If it's the replicator schedule, talk to ops.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_49_2: It's not the replicator. It's never us.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_4_3: Morning. You look how I feel.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_51_1: Chief's in the tubes. Can I help?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_53_1: Sorry. Didn't mean to block the corridor.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_62_1: Careful, that row's just been planted.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_64_1: You here for the tea list?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_64_2: If it's about the tea, you're on the list.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_65_1: Grab a trowel if you're staying.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_65_2: Need a job? We have jobs.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_66_1: Afternoon. Smells good down here, doesn't it?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_67_1: Hello. The worms are through there, if you're brave.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_68_1: Evening. The arboretum's quiet, if you need it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_71_1: Want a drink? Chit's on me.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_72_1: Oh, hi. Didn't see you there.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_73_1: Are you eating? Grieg's got soup.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_75_1: Welcome to the best room on the ship.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_76_1: You look like you need a raktajino.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_77_1: Evening. We're one short for cards.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_7_3: Lieutenant. I think. Sorry, I'm terrible with pips.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_81_1: Take a seat. Someone will be right with you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_81_2: Sit anywhere. We'll get to you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_82_1: Oh, hello. Didn't see you come in.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_83_2: Get some sleep. You look done in.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_86_2: Lab's through there, if you're looking for it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_87_2: Hello. Don't stand on pad three.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_88_2: Beaming out? You're not on the schedule.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_89_1: Transporter room. How can I help?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_90_1: Oh. Hello. Didn't hear the doors.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_91_1: If you're here for Kess, she's in ops.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_hello_93_1: Nice to see a face that didn't just materialise.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_100_1: Water the oak. Don't forget the oak.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_103_1: Replicator ration's down to four minutes. Four.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_104_1: Who took the last raktajino pattern slot?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_105_1: Grieg's bread day. The whole deck smells like home.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_106_1: Same planet in the window. Every day.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_107_2: I'm owed three chits by somebody.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_108_1: Earl Grey, hot. ... No, the other hot.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_109_1: Holodeck list's out. Twenty minutes. Twenty.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_109_2: I got Tuesday at two AM.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_10_1: Five months. Five months in orbit.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_110_1: Who left oskoid in the stasis unit again?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_111_1: Is that leola? Is Tessik cooking?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_112_1: Talent night, Friday. Somebody sign up.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_113_1: Humming. Just humming. Don't mind me.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_114_1: Four more weeks of real coffee. I did the maths.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_114_2: Real coffee runs out in October.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_116_1: Where are the cobbler ration packs?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_116_2: Somebody's been eating all the cobbler.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_117_1: Wash, rinse, stack. Wash, rinse, stack.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_118_1: Kurag's still angry about the gagh.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_119_1: Nobody's opening the Romulan ale. Nobody.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_11_1: Holodeck rota. Where am I on the holodeck rota?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_120_1: One more letter for the unsent file.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_121_1: Is the lift working? It stuck again on Deck 3.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_122_1: There's a light down there. No. Gone.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_122_2: Was that a light on the surface? No.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_123_2: Why does this bed never hold its settings?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_123_3: Come on, you stubborn thing. Calibrate.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_125_1: Two beds made. Always two beds made.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_125_2: Fresh linens on four. Just in case.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_126_1: Regenerator cell's at sixty percent. Hm.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_126_2: This cell won't last the week.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_128_1: I'll ask the Doctor. He'll have read something.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_128_2: Note to self: ask the Doctor about that reading.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_129_1: If one more person asks me for a stimulant...
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_129_2: No stimulants. I'm putting up a sign.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_12_1: Did I lock my console? I locked my console.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_130_1: The office door's shut. They're at it again.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_130_2: Anwar and the Doctor. Round five, I think.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_131_1: Label, seal, log. Label, seal, log.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_131_2: Sample tray, cold storage, log it. Done.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_132_1: Quiet shift. I hate quiet shifts.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_132_2: Too quiet. Somebody's about to sprain something.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_133_1: Tea, water, bed. That's the headache protocol now.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_133_2: The new treatment for headaches is Grieg's tea.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_134_1: Where's the gauze? Who moved the gauze?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_135_1: Trauma kit by the door. Always ready.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_135_2: Surface kit's packed. Just in case somebody calls.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_136_1: Is it gamma shift already? It feels like gamma shift.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_136_2: I could sleep for a week.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_137_1: Another protocol update. Forty pages. He never sleeps.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_137_2: The Doctor revised the protocols again. Of course.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_138_1: Two hundred and twelve ceiling panels. I've counted.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_138_2: Five months in orbit. I know every tile in this room.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_139_1: Same markers. Same markers. Same markers.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_139_2: Confusing markers. That's the official term now.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_13_1: Come on, come on, come on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_143_1: Kess wants this certified by nineteen hundred. Of course she does.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_144_1: Don't lean on the rail. Nobody ever listens.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_146_2: Log's up to date. One more name.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_147_2: One more. One more for the list.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_148_1: Point-oh-one. That's the note. That's the right note.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_149_1: Signal's weak down there. Rain. It's always rain.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_14_1: What is that noise? Oh. Ventilation.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_150_1: If you can hear me down there... hold on. We're coming.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_151_1: Grieg's asking for her crate back. Still.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_152_1: Eleven lines. Some filled. Some not yet.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_15_1: If one more thing breaks today.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_18_1: Letter home. Can't send it. Writing it anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_19_1: The transporter works. At least the transporter works.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_20_1: Another survivor came up. Good. Good.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_22_1: Dinner, then bed. Dinner, then bed.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_25_1: Don't think about it. Don't think about it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_26_3: What did I come in here for?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_27_2: You can hear the core from here.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_2_1: Where did I leave that padd?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_31_1: Hmm. Coolant pressure's up a point. Rhel will know.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_33_1: Plotting a course. Just to plot one.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_35_1: Fire on the east road. Nobody's fighting it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_37_1: Where did I put my coffee?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_38_1: Probe's on its way. Hour to go.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_39_1: Captain's still in her ready room.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_3_1: Two more hours. Two more hours.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_40_1: One hundred and seven diagnostics. Clean. Every one.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_41_1: Hodgkin's Law. Laboratory conditions. Who built the lab?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_42_1: Their calendar says 1993. Ours says 2435. Fine. Fine.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_43_1: Moonrise Road. Not on any Earth map. Adding it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_44_1: Shuttle telemetry's in. Still full of lamps.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_45_1: Wild ground. Always wild ground. Never a town.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_47_1: Come on, come on. Stay green.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_49_1: Where did I put the hyperspanner?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_4_1: I'd kill for a real coffee.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_50_2: If nineteen fuses again, I'm moving out.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_51_2: Run it again. Run it again.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_52_1: One crystal in, two on the rack.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_55_1: She's running warm. Just a touch.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_55_2: Little warm. Nothing to worry about.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_56_2: Is the cart on the ceiling again?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_58_1: Someday I'm going to fix the impulse manifold. Someday.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_59_1: The transporter's perfect. Nothing else is. But the transporter's perfect.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_61_1: Coffee. I need coffee. Real coffee.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_61_2: Is there any coffee in this room?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_62_1: The chief's been in since four. Again.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_63_1: Crate of seals. Crate of seals. Where does this go?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_63_2: Who labelled this crate spares? Everything's spares.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_64_2: Galley draw's up. Must be lunch.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_67_1: Wild ground. Always wild ground. Why?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_67_2: Never under a town. Not one crystal.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_6_2: Four hours. Four whole hours. Luxury.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_70_1: Twenty minutes in the shower. Twenty.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_72_1: Dear Mum. Still here. Still fine.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_77_1: Who has the little dog piece?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_7_1: Stew again. It's fine. It's fine.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_82_1: My bunk's too short. It's been too short since February.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_83_1: The recycler hums in B flat. I've checked.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_87_1: Hasperat's nearly ready. Don't touch your eyes.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_88_1: Earl Grey in three weeks. Three weeks.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_89_2: That's it. Reach for the light.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_90_1: Who left the worm tank lid off?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_91_1: Seed locker's low on tea. I'll replicate some.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_92_1: Tuber corner's at four degrees. Perfect.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_93_1: Grow lights cycling. Row two, lights down.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_94_1: Beans are drying. Nobody open the dehydrator.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_95_1: Harvest, replant, prime. Harvest, replant, prime.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_99_1: Needs more light. Everything needs more light.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_idle_9_1: One hundred and forty-one. Minus eleven.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_leave_10_1: Deck four. And step on it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_leave_11_1: Holodeck. It's my turn. It's finally my turn.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_10_1: That's what they wear down there? Honestly?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_11_1: Does the replicator even have that pattern?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_11_2: How did you get that pattern?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_12_1: You've been on the surface, haven't you? It's the clothes.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_12_2: You smell a bit of the surface. No offence. It's the clothes.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_14_1: Are you one of ours? Sorry. I don't know your face.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_14_2: I don't think I've seen you on this deck.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_15_1: Is that a flannel shirt? The historians would kill for that.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_17_1: Did you just beam up? You've still got mud on you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_18_1: Does security know you're up here? Only asking.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_18_2: Hm. Have you checked in with security?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_19_1: I like the shoes. Are they comfortable?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_19_2: Those shoes have laces. Real laces.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_1_1: That's a strange outfit you have on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_20_1: You look like an exhibit from the shuttle. In a nice way.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_20_2: You look like you walked out of one of Shepard's tapes.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_21_1: Is that the survivor look? It's working.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_22_1: Where on earth did you get that? Well. Not Earth. You know what I mean.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_22_2: Where did you find that? Actually, don't tell me.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_23_1: Tell me that's not a real bloodstain.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_23_2: Is that... paint? Please say paint.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_24_1: That shirt says the name of a gas station.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_24_2: Your shirt has a logo on it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_25_1: Stores can issue you a uniform, you know. Deck four.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_27_1: Sorry. Stop staring. I'm stopping. It's just... the outfit.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_27_2: I'm not staring. I'm admiring. It's different.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_28_1: Did you raid Shepard's shuttle? She'll want that back.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_28_2: If that's from the shuttle, put it back before she notices.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_29_1: That's a strange outfit you have on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_30_2: Did you get that from the surface?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_32_1: Is there a uniform shortage I don't know about?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_33_1: Don't let the captain see you in that. Actually, she wouldn't mind.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_34_1: Casual Friday? We don't have casual Friday. Do we?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_35_1: Are you one of Shepard's specimens? She'd love that coat.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_36_1: That's either civilian or very undercover.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_37_1: Quartermaster's on deck three. Just saying.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_38_1: Hazard gear would be better than whatever that is.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_38_2: Is that fabric flammable? It looks flammable.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_39_1: You can't wear that near the core.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_39_2: That's not regulation near the plasma.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_3_2: Is that from the shuttle's collection?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_40_1: Did you walk in from the shuttle bay? The historical corner?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_41_1: Sleeves like that catch on things. Mind the conduits.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_41_2: Tuck that in before it gets caught in something.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_42_1: Are you... supposed to be in Engineering?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_43_1: Nice jacket. Keep it away from the injectors.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_44_1: That'll be a surface outfit, then.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_44_2: Did somebody beam you up in that?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_45_1: That's a strange outfit you have on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_48_1: Nice jacket. Shepard would have questions.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_49_1: Do the pockets go all the way down?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_4_1: Are you... cleared to be up here?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_50_1: Is that what they wear down there?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_51_1: Interesting clothes. Good for gardening, though.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_52_1: Is that from down there? It'd do for the tray bay.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_53_1: You're not in uniform. Mind the soil on it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_54_1: Nice jacket. You'll want to keep it off the worm tank.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_55_1: Now that looks like proper farm wear.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_56_1: Where'd you get those? They look like somebody's Sunday best.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_57_1: Out of uniform on Deck 5? The plants don't mind.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_58_1: That's a strange outfit you have on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_59_1: Is that from down there? The 1990s?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_60_2: Why are there rivets on your trousers?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_63_1: Is that a shirt with a word on it? What does it mean?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_63_2: What's the writing on your shirt about?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_64_1: That jacket's got a hood. For weather, I suppose.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_65_1: Are you with Shepard's survey? That's very authentic.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_65_2: Is that for the cultural survey? Very convincing.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_66_1: The galley has a dress code. Sort of.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_68_1: That's a strange outfit. Is that... cotton?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_69_1: Where did you get those clothes?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_69_2: That's not a standard uniform, is it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_70_1: Were you on the surface in those? Scanned, I hope?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_70_2: Are those from down there? Been through decon?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_72_1: Is that denim? I've only ever seen it in archives.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_73_1: Please tell me that went through the biofilter.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_73_2: Did those clothes come through the transporter filter?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_7_1: Is that a costume? For the holodeck?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_7_2: Holodeck party I wasn't told about?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_9_1: I love the jacket. I don't understand it, but I love it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_outfit_9_2: That jacket has a lot of pockets.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_andori: Lieutenant th'Zoran's Andorian too. She'll be glad of the company.
Have you met Kess? From the transporter room? You'd get on.
Cold enough for you? We can turn it down.
Is the ship too warm for you?
Your antennae are doing a thing. Is that good?
Morning. Straight talk, please. It's been a long week.
Good. Somebody who'll just say it.
Hello. Nobody argues with an Andorian at the transporter schedule.
Kess runs the pads like an Andorian. Because she is one.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_bajora: The chief's Bajoran too. You'll have seen him talking to the core.
Have you met Rhel? He'll talk your ear off. In Bajoran.
There's a small shrine on deck two. Somebody set it up in March.
If you need it, there's a quiet room on deck two with candles.
Hasperat in the galley on Fridays. Grieg tried. It's hot.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_betazo: Oh. You probably know what I'm thinking. Sorry about that.
Please ignore whatever I'm feeling. It's been a week.
Counselor Tren's looking for help. If you've got time.
You and Tren should have tea. She's busy. Help her.
Hello. Don't read me before coffee.
You must feel the whole ship some days. That can't be easy.
A hundred and forty-one worried people. How do you stand it?
Is it loud in here? For you, I mean.
Is the ship noisy for you?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_exborg: Hello. Sorry. I didn't mean to stare.
If the ship's noise bothers you, deck two's quietest at night.
Sickbay's got a quiet room, if you ever need one.
You're very welcome here. I mean that.
Does the implant hurt? Sorry. None of my business.
Hello. You're one of us here. That's all.
Hello. Do you hear it too? The hum? Down there? Sorry. Forget I asked.
They say you hear something near the dead. I'm sorry. That must be hard.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_klingo: A warrior. Good. We need more of those.
Good to have a warrior aboard.
Have you tried Grieg's stew? It's the closest thing to real food here.
Grieg does a real roast on Sundays. Not replicated. You'd approve.
There's a bat'leth drill in the gym on Thursdays.
Today is a good day to... have lunch.
Today is a good day. Truly.
You didn't hear it from me, but there's bloodwine in cargo bay two.
K'teral in engineering is looking for a sparring partner.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_talaxi: Oh, you must meet Grieg. The galley needs you.
You always cheer this corridor up.
Leola root? Please say you haven't brought leola root.
Morning! You've got that face. The good face.
Grieg says you're the best morale officer she's never had.
Somebody said you made the galley laugh yesterday. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_trill_: Morning. Both of you. All of you? How many of you are there?
Hello to you, and to whoever else is in there.
Ensign Daro's joined too. You two should compare notes.
You and Daro could start a club.
Does the symbiont mind being stuck in orbit?
Morning. Any of your previous hosts ever been stranded? Any tips?
Did any of you ever do anything like this before?
I love your spots. Is that rude? Sorry.
Nice to see you. Spots and all.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_species_vulcan: Good day. The logical thing would be sleep, but here we are.
You must find all this very illogical.
Plomeek soup in the galley. Grieg makes it properly.
Taval in engineering could use a calm voice.
Is it true you don't mind the orbit? Five months and no complaints?
You'd tell me if it was bothering you. Wouldn't you?
Morning. You make the rest of us look very emotional.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_10_1: Thanks for the hands. Tray's done.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_10_2: Thank you. That saved me an hour.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_11_1: You brought seeds? Thank you. The locker was nearly empty.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_12_1: Thanks for helping with the harvest.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_13_1: Thank you. K'teral will never say it, so I will.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_14_1: Thanks for feeding the worms. They're grateful. Probably.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_15_1: Were you the one who called in the last one? Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_15_2: I don't know if it was you. But thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_16_1: Every one who comes up, we can help. Thank you for that.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_17_1: Somebody down there keeps sending us people. Was that you?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_17_2: Are you the one bringing them up? You are, aren't you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_18_1: Two beds made. For whoever you find next.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_18_2: Keep them coming. We'll be ready.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_19_1: The last ensign said somebody helped. Was it you?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_19_2: Somebody found our people. If it's you, thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_1_1: Is it you? Beaming them up? Thank you. If it is.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_20_1: I don't know who you are. But thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_20_2: Thank you. Truly. Whoever you are.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_21_1: Bring them home. We'll do the rest.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_21_2: You find them, we fix them. Deal?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_22_1: Was that you? Last night? Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_22_2: If that was you... thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_23_1: Whoever's been bringing them up. Thank you. I mean it.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_24_1: You were down there? You found one of ours? Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_25_1: I don't know who you are. But thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_26_1: Novak would thank you herself. She's still in sickbay. So, from her.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_27_1: Thank you. We can't get down there. You can. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_28_1: Every name on my list, somebody found. If it's you, thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_29_1: You look like somebody who knows the ground. Thanks, if it's you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_2_1: Thank you. For the survivors. I think it's you. Is it you?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_2_2: If you're the one on the surface, thank you. Really.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_30_1: Sickbay says you keep them alive long enough. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_31_1: I owe you a drink. Or my holodeck time. Take your pick.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_32_1: Grieg's saving you a pie. If it's you. It might be you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_33_2: Thank you for going down there.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_3_1: Reyes came up last week. Somebody found her. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_3_2: My friend came up on the pad. If that was you, I owe you everything.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_4_1: Someone's bringing them home. I hope it's you. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_4_2: Somebody down there is bringing us our people. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_5_1: Every crystal that comes up, somebody carried. Thanks for carrying.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_5_2: That dilithium didn't walk to the pad by itself. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_6_1: I don't know who you are, but thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_7_1: The transporter crew says hello. They wave at every lock. Thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_7_2: Th'Zoran would say thank you, if she said thank you. So I will.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_8_1: Stay safe down there. And thank you.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_9_1: You look like somebody who's been down there. Thank you for coming back.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_BARK_thanks_9_2: Thanks for everything you're doing down there.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_bridge_captain_worr: Do you know what she said to me yesterday? I told her I was bored.
I asked her once if she was worried. You know what she said?
What?
Go on.
Ensign, a ship in orbit is a ship on duty. Then she smiled.
She said, I'm always worried. That's what the pips are for.
That's her.
Dry as a Vulcan desert.
She's coming. Look busy.
Captain on the bridge.
I'm always busy.
We are busy. We are extremely busy.
Back to it, then.
Right. Tidy watch.
Stations.
Tidy watch.
Stations.
And someone take her a sandwich. A real one, from Grieg.
I'll ask Grieg to send up soup. She eats if it's put in front of her.
Put my name on it. She'll eat it to be polite.
Good plan.
We should do something. Make it easier for her.
We could take some of the load. The small things.
Like what?
What would help?
Be good at our jobs. Not add to the pile.
Run a tidy watch. Don't give her one more thing.
I can do that.
That, I can manage.
Easy. Mostly.
I found her in the transporter room once. Middle of the night.
The transporter chief says she comes down when a beacon's live.
Waiting?
For a rescue?
For a beam that was scheduled for noon. She sat there all night.
For anyone. She stands by the pad and waits. Doesn't sit down.
Did it come?
Did they come up?
At dawn. Ensign Haddad, off a roof. She was the first face he saw.
Not that night. She went back up to the bridge and said nothing.
She carries every one of them.
That's the whole job, for her.
The eleven are on a padd on her desk. Names, last known.
She keeps the eleven on a padd by her chair. Crosses nobody off.
She gave her holodeck time to the night shift. All of it.
When the ration board went up, she put herself at the bottom.
She knows every name aboard. Every one. Hundred and forty-one.
She learned the whole crew roster in a week. Every name.
She knows the eleven too. By heart.
She still says their names.
I'd follow her anywhere.
I would too. Wherever.
We're not going anywhere.
That's lucky, then. We're staying put.
She walked deck six at three a.m. I passed her by the lift.
Grieg says she's in the galley at odd hours, just sitting.
What was she doing?
Did she say anything?
Checking on people. Knocking on doors. Asking if they were all right.
Said good morning. It was the middle of the night.
Has she slept since February?
I don't think she's slept since February.
Properly? No.
I think she sleeps sitting up.
Has the captain eaten today?
Did you see Vale this morning?
Anyone seen the captain eat anything?
Coffee. Two, at least.
She had soup. Some of it.
Not since yesterday, as far as I know.
That's not food.
That doesn't count.
That's something.
Tren should say something.
Does the counselor know?
The counselor knows. She's on it. She's on everybody.
Tren has a list. The captain's on it. She's on everyone's list.
Busy.
Tren is very busy. We're all on her list.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_bridge_county_senso: Somebody down there has been beaming our people up. One at a time.
The transporter room has had a busy month.
Somebody on the ground's doing what we can't.
Whoever it is, I'd buy them dinner. If I had any replicator credit.
I'd buy them two.
I'd give them my holodeck time.
Life signs?
What do the life signs say?
The same as yesterday, roughly.
Scattered. Fewer. Hard to read.
And the other readings. The ones that move and aren't alive.
And the others. The ones the sensors can't decide about.
Don't. Not tonight.
I know. I've seen them.
We call them readings. It helps.
There's a fire west of the big town. It started an hour ago.
Heat bloom, west side. Something's burning.
Houses?
Is it spreading?
A street of them. Nobody's putting it out.
Slowly. Nobody's fighting it.
There's no fire service left.
There's nobody to call.
In June, that would have had four trucks on it inside ten minutes.
In June there'd have been sirens. I used to hear them in the audio sweep.
Get some sleep after this. You look like I feel.
Don't stay on past shift change. It doesn't help them.
After the next sweep.
One more pass. Then I'm done.
Generators run out. That's all it may be.
Fuel runs out. It doesn't have to mean anything.
I know.
I know it doesn't.
That's what I tell myself.
One of them came on every evening at nine. Regular as a chronometer.
There was one that blinked. On, off, on. Like somebody checking.
You were watching one window?
You've been counting their lights.
Somebody should.
It's the night watch. What else is there to watch?
Lamp's on.
There. The lamp's on.
Ridge farmhouse. Lamp's on.
Good.
Good. That's good.
Log it.
Logged.
Logged. Farmhouse, lamp, alive.
Do you remember the radio? The county station?
I used to leave the audio sweep on their radio station. Night shift.
The one with the farm prices?
The call-in show. The man with the dog.
Farm prices at six. Then a man who played records until midnight.
Swap meet on Saturdays. Somebody always selling a tractor tyre.
I liked the weather. He was always wrong about the weather.
I knew the jingle. I still know the jingle.
It went to a recorded message on the thirtieth. Then static.
It played an emergency tone for a day. Then nothing.
I didn't know his name.
We never even learned his name.
Shepard might. She'd know.
Shepard will have it written down.
You know what the order says. Observe only.
We observe. That was the whole posting.
I know what it says.
I've read the order, {sci}.
I didn't sign up to watch a town go out one window at a time.
Observing was fine when it was market days and radio.
No. None of us did.

I think that's what she wanted.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_bridge_shift_change: Where's the captain?
Is Vale still up?
Went to her ready room at oh-two-hundred. Hasn't come out.
Walked the decks all night. Said she'd sleep. I don't believe her.
She'll be up. She's always up.
She never sleeps. You know that.
Someone should make her rest.
Has anyone told Tren?
Try it. I'll watch.
Tren tried. She got a very polite no.
That's everything. Try to stay awake.
That's the watch. It's all yours. Enjoy the view.
Get some sleep.
Go eat.
Go. Before something happens.
Nothing ever happens.
If something happens, don't tell me.
Wake me if we move.
If we move, I'm telling everyone.
We won't. But I'd love it.
Anything happen?
Tell me something exciting happened.
The ship orbited. Twice.
We went round. Then round again.
Planet's still there. We checked.
I plotted a very good course to nowhere.
I kept us in orbit.
Don't forget, I held a very steady orbit.
{third} held a very steady orbit.
Superb flying, as ever.
Before you go. Is the pool still open?
Did you put in for the pool?
What pool?
The pool's still going?
The warp pool. Pick the day Rhel gets the core to take a warp field.
Everyone puts in a ration bar and a date. Closest date takes the lot.
I've got the fourteenth of September.
I said Christmas. Earth's.
That's optimistic.
That's a bleak one.
Grieg has tomorrow. She's had tomorrow every day since March.
Rhel's not allowed in. He'd have an unfair advantage.
Put me down for the first of October.
Put me down for next week.
Done. One ration bar. Pay up.
Noted. I want that bar by noon.
Is the holodeck schedule posted?
Did you get my holodeck slot?
Friday. Twenty minutes. Kess was being generous.
Next week. Kess says your last program ran over.
By thirty seconds!
That was one extra lap.
Thirty seconds of a sailing program. It was very nice sailing.
Kess counts seconds. Kess counts everything.
Replicator queue's backed up on deck four. Somebody wanted cake.
Two coolant alarms in engineering. Rhel says they're fine.
Galley's out of coffee substitute until Grieg says otherwise.
Understood.
Noted.
That's a crisis.
Long-range: nothing. Probe out, coming back in an hour.
Comms: still dark. Sensors: quiet. Transporter: on standby.
And the surface?
Anything from below?
The county?
Two new fires on the east side. The ridge farmhouse lamp came on at ten.
Quiet. One beacon flickered around midnight, then held. Kess has it.
The lamp's still going. I checked twice.
I always check the lamp.
Shepard came up asking for her shuttle's telemetry. Again.
Oh, and Shepard wants to beam something up off her shuttle again.
For what?
What is it this time?
A lamp. A floor lamp. From nineteen ninety-three. Kess said no.
A cassette deck. She says it's a specimen. I say it's a radio.
We're going to need a bigger shuttle.
Her shuttle's already got a fridge in it. A fridge.
Relieving you, {off}.
Morning. Here to take over.
I'm your relief. Report?
Oh, thank you.
At last.
You're early. Bless you.
I stand relieved.
You have the watch.
Watch is yours.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_bridge_wrong_detail: And there's the calendar.
Then there's the date.
Their calendar says 1993. Ours says 2435.
Well, it's a parallel world. Why shouldn't it be behind?
Because it runs at Earth's rate. A copy that runs can't lag.
Because it isn't slow. Their year is our year, same length.
I've checked it four times. So did Shepard. It doesn't add up.
It shouldn't read 1993. And it does. And nobody can say why.
And nobody ever explained Miri either.
You sound like the Miri file. Earth, but it can't be.
Here's my favourite. Dilithium.
The best one isn't on the list. It's the dilithium.
It's in the wild ground. Fields. Woods. Never under a town.
The probes find it in the country and never beneath a street.
Maybe towns just dug it all out.
Maybe they mined it.
They don't know it exists. They've never mined a gram.
Nobody down there knows what it is. The towns sit on bare rock.
So the ground knew something the towns didn't.
So what does that mean?
That's strange.
I don't know. That's why it's my favourite.
Nobody knows. I love it.
Put it on the list.
Three hundred and thirteen, then.
Add one for me. Scientist who won't sleep.
Already have.
Filed. I'll bring it up at the briefing.
It's on there. It's on there twice.
They have a soda I can't find in any Earth record.
Their cereal mascots are wrong. I have a whole subsection.
You have a subsection on cereal.
You catalogued the cereal.
Material culture, {other}. It's what Shepard came here for.
Shepard sent me the boxes. She'd want it catalogued properly.
Is that why her shuttle's full of old furniture?
That's method. She'll tell you so. At length.
Specimens. Every chair of it. Don't call it clutter to her face.
Isn't this what Hodgkin's Law says? Similar worlds, similar results.
Parallel development. Hodgkin's Law. Page one of the posting brief.
Hodgkin's Law under laboratory conditions. Same land, same people.
Hodgkin, yes. The best test of it anybody ever ran.
Except nobody built the laboratory on purpose. Or we don't think so.
Which raises the question of who set up the experiment.
The Miri anomaly. Twenty-two sixty-six. Earth's continents.
Kirk's crew found a planet with Earth's cities. Never explained.
That's the filing category. It has two entries now. Miri, and us.
Starfleet has one folder for this. We're the second thing in it.
And the Q theory?
Half the ship thinks it's Q.
A respectable theory. I haven't ruled it out.
Sensible people hold it. I'd want more than a hunch.
Found another one.
Add it to the list.
Here's today's.
Another what?
Go on, then.
How many is that now?
Another wrong thing. A difference.
A discrepancy. My list.
Number three hundred and twelve on the list.
There's a town down there with a street called Moonrise Road.
There's a Chestnut Lane on the map where Earth never had one.
I checked the Federation archive. On Earth, it was never there.
Same bend of river, same town, and the street isn't in Earth's records.
Maybe somebody renamed it.
A different mayor. A different vote.
That's exactly my point. It grew. Nobody drew it. It grew.
That's the finding. Near-identical where the land decides.
Wrong wherever people did the deciding.
And wrong in a hundred little ways that people decided.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_calendar_calend: I've got a paper calendar in my quarters. From the surface. Ninety-three.
Shepard gave me a calendar. Paper. With pictures of ducks.
Ducks. Every month a different duck. July is a very handsome duck.
Lighthouses. Twelve lighthouses. None of them are anywhere we've mapped.
I want one. Where do I get one?
Ask Shepard. She's got a box of them. From a gas station.
The shuttle. There's a stack of them behind the sofa.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_calendar_end_it: I cross the days off. It helps. Somehow it helps.
I cross the days off on the duck. Don't ask me why.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_calendar_maths_: Science checked it about fifty times. It doesn't add up.
It shouldn't be ninety-three. It should be now. Nobody can say why.
Shepard said nobody explained Miri either.
Maybe time just runs odd there.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_calendar_start_: What's the date? Down there, I mean.
What day is it on the surface?
Four hundred and forty-two years. It still makes my head hurt.
Ninety-three. And it's twenty-four thirty-five up here.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_calendar_street: Speaking of which. The map's wrong. Have you noticed?
Science found a street down there with the wrong name. Wrong for Earth.
Close to Earth's. Not the same. Like somebody retold it from memory.
Nearly right. Everything down there is nearly right.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_friend_in_sickb: And you get some sleep yourself. You look like you need a bed.
And eat something. I don't want you in there next.
Yes, doctor.
I will. Promise.
I'm not a doctor. I just work with two.
Don't let the Doctor hear that.
I can't give you details. But she's resting, and she's eating.
I saw her this morning. She complained about the food. That's a good sign.
Complaining is good?
Oh, thank goodness.
Complaining is excellent. The quiet ones worry us.
The Doctor says a patient who complains is a patient who's going home.
Then she'll be out in an hour. She complains professionally.
She's the best complainer on the ship. She'll be fine.
Then she'll know it's you.
Perfect. She'll recover out of spite.
That's the plan.
That's always been the plan.
You're from sickbay, aren't you? Can I ask you something?
Sorry to stop you. You work with Dr. Anwar?
I am. What is it?
For a minute. What's wrong?
My friend's in there. Since yesterday. Nobody's telling me anything.
Ensign Tamura. My bunkmate. She went in last night.
I'm not on her case. But Dr. Anwar is. She's in good hands.
I don't know. I'm sorry. I work in the lab. I'll ask.
Would you? Please.
Thank you. I'd owe you.
I'll get word to you by end of shift. I promise.
Of course. Where will you be?
Deck two. Quarters. Or the galley. Probably the galley.
Anywhere near a comm panel. Pacing.
Can I see her?
Are visits allowed?
After gamma shift. Bring her something from the galley.
Tomorrow, probably. The Doctor's strict about visiting hours.
I will. Thank you. Really.
I'll bring the stew. She hates the stew.
What happened to her? Do you know?
Was it an accident?
She was helping on the transporter pad. A survivor grabbed her arm.
She fainted in the galley. Just went down. Hasn't slept in weeks.
Then she's in the right place. They'll look after her.
The Doctor's thorough. Maddeningly thorough. That's good for her.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_defend_1: He brought me tea when I was on the night watch. Twice.
He helped carry a survivor off the pad. Soaked his uniform.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_defend_3: It means he brought me tea.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_defend_4: All right. I take it back. A bit.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_rumours_: That he's not really Intelligence. That he's the other thing.
I heard he's Section 31. I heard Shepard said it to his face.
That's what I heard. And that he laughed.
And that he didn't deny it?
I heard he did deny it. And that nobody believed him but her.
The way I heard it, he said no. And that was the scary part.
Because if it wasn't his people, then whose was it?
Because then nobody knows who did this. Not even them.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_shaken_1: Someone saw him coming out of sickbay last week. Looking awful.
Th'Zoran said he looked shaken. After the Doctor's report.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_shaken_3: Nobody knows. Something about markers. Confusing ones.
Something about the samples. That's all anyone says.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_shaken_4: The Doctor's never confused. He'd rather die. Well. Be deactivated.
Confusing markers. That's not a phrase I like.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_start_1_: Was that Cmdr. Okafor? Just now?
Did you see who got out of the lift?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_start_2_: Intelligence liaison. Walks like he's counting doors.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_start_3_: Is it true what they say? About where he's really from?
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_stop_1_2: Keep it down in the lifts. They carry.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_stop_3_1: Good. Rumours on a ship this size are how people get hurt.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_stop_3_2: The commander's doing his job. Let's all do ours.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_stop_5_1: For what it's worth, he asked after the eleven. Every one. By name.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_okafor_stop_5_2: And for the record, I've seen him in the chapel. Twice.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_ga: Grieg threw a replicator padd across the galley.
Somebody complained about Grieg's stew. To her face.
Some ensign from sciences. He apologised twice and asked for seconds.
Nobody knows. She's put the stew on the menu three days running now.
That's a punishment. That's a whole-ship punishment.
I like the stew. Don't tell anyone.
The stew's fine. It's honest stew.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_ho: Someone booked the holodeck for six hours. Six. With a forged rota.
The holodeck rota went missing and came back with one name added.
Nobody's saying. The program was a beach. Just a beach, all six hours.
They ran a rainstorm. That's all. Six hours of rain.
Me too. I'd give a week's rations for real rain.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_la: Oh no, is that the time? I'm on in two minutes.
I'm late. I'm very late. Tell nobody I stopped.
Go. Run. Don't run, security hates it. Walk fast.
Walk fast. And look like you're carrying something important.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_of: I have to go. Save me anything else.
Right. I'm late. Keep me posted.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_re: Right. My turn. The Captain laughed on the bridge yesterday.
I've got one. Somebody saw Ensign Daro practising the helm. With no helm.
Mine's better. Th'Zoran smiled at a transporter log.
Nobody knows. It was brief. It happened.
That's all I know. It's plenty.
That's going round the whole ship by lunch.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_ro: Pell Daro and somebody from stellar cartography. In the lounge. Holding hands.
Two of the night-shift sensor crew. Sharing a dessert ration.
Sharing a ration? That's practically a proposal.
No. On this ship? That's serious.
Does the symbiont approve? Daro's got three previous opinions on everything.
Good for them. Somebody should be happy up here.
Apparently the second host was a romantic.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_shift_gossip_st: Did you hear about deck two last night?
You'll never guess who I saw.
Have you got a minute? You have to hear this.
I've got about thirty seconds. Go.
Is it good? Tell me it's good.
Morning, {a}. Is this gossip? Your face says gossip.
It's the best thing that's happened since February. Nearly.
It's small. It's very small. But it's lovely.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_captain_clo: You know she gave up her replicator ration to the survivors? All of it.
She sends her coffee ration down to sickbay. For whoever came up last.
I'd follow her anywhere. Even nowhere. Especially nowhere.
Good captain. Good person. Tired person.
Me too. Right. Let's go and be less trouble for her.
Same. Come on. Let's make her day easier.
Starting with not being late. Come on.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_captain_kin: She does that. She checks on everybody. On the night watch too.
She walks the ship. My friend in hydro says she knows every name.
Every name? All hundred and forty-one?
She said good morning to me by name. I've been aboard three months.
Every one. Including the eleven. She says their names at night.
Every one. She keeps the eleven on a list in her ready room.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_captain_rum: People say she argued with Okafor. In the ready room. Door closed.
Someone heard raised voices from the ready room. Hers.
The Captain doesn't raise her voice.
Nobody knows. Might be nothing. Might be the eleven.
Might have been about going down there. Getting them all back.
Then good. Somebody should be shouting about it.
If she's shouting, she's shouting for us. I'm fine with that.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_captain_sta: Did the Captain look tired to you this morning?
She always looks tired. Since February.
She was in the galley at oh-three-hundred. Just sitting there.
Somebody saw her walking the decks at night. Every deck. All of them.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_captain_sto: You know what she said on the tenth? When they told her about the drives?
Did you hear what she said, the day after?
Well. We've always wanted to see the place properly. Now we have time.
She said: then we'll be the best-kept orbital platform in the quadrant.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_captain_wor: Dr. Anwar tried. The Captain gave her the look.
Counselor Tren tried. They had tea. The Captain didn't sleep.
The dry one. Where she agrees with you and does nothing about it.
You know the one. Eyebrow. Very small. Devastating.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_arriv: Here. This is fine. Thank you. Really.
Right here. Thank you so much.
Why didn't you use the antigrav cart?
The cart's on the ceiling again. That's why I'm carrying it.
I would have used the cart, but it's in engineering, and it's up.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_bye_1: Next time, find me first. I'm stronger than I look.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_bye_2: Next time, I'm waiting for the cart.
Next time I'm hiring the Klingons.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_drop_: Nothing broke that wasn't already broken.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_start: Excuse me. Excuse me. Very heavy crate.
Oh, yes. Thank you. The far end.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_thank: I'll tell Grieg you helped. She keeps a list.
Real coffee. Surface beans. Somebody beamed up a whole tin.
The best list. People on it get the crusty bits of the bread.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_what_: What's in it? It weighs a ton.
Seals. Couplings. And, for some reason, a toaster.
Surface salvage. Came up the transporter this morning.
Lieutenant Shepard says it's a specimen. The chief says it's parts.
Somebody found it in a field. It's going to the shuttle bay.
Nobody. The toaster sits in the corridor.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_crate_where: Cargo bay two. Then engineering. Then maybe cargo bay two again.
Shuttle bay. The long way, the lift's full.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_ensigns_how: How did they find her? Nobody's beamed down in weeks.
How? Who marked her for transport?
Somebody on the surface. Th'Zoran got a lock from an odd signal.
Nobody knows. There was a signal. She was just there on the pad.
Somebody down there is doing it. Someone brave.
She said somebody found her. She didn't get a good look. Just a voice.
She says a stranger. That's all. A stranger who knew about us.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_ensigns_lef: That leaves... how many still down there?
I keep a count. I don't say it out loud.
I don't know. I stopped counting. I didn't like counting.
They're not dead until we know.
We don't know. That's the thing.
We don't know. That's hope and it's horrible.
Not knowing is the worst part.
Print_Text_TREK_CREW_cor_the_ensigns_sta: Another one came up yesterday. From the surface.
